concept: Bitemporal Knowledge Graphs and Entity Resolution
summary: Valid-time and transaction-time bitemporal models combined with probabilistic entity resolution (Fellegi-Sunter) for audit-grade knowledge graphs.

related.concept: Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining
Graph-Structured Agent Episodic and Semantic Memory Architecture
Graph-Guided Hallucination Mitigation and Factual Consistency Verification

facts.text: Bitemporal knowledge representations maintain two orthogonal temporal dimensions—valid time (when a relationship held in the real world) and transaction/system time (when the fact was recorded), enabling deterministic point-in-time state reconstruction and auditing.

Probabilistic entity resolution under the Fellegi-Sunter methodology assigns log-likelihood ratio weights across blocking keys to link multi-source entity mentions with bounded false-positive merge rates.

Deep learning entity resolution (cross-encoder bi-encoders and LLM tie-breakers) achieves F1-scores > 0.90 on benchmark datasets (e.g. DBLP-ACM, Amazon-Google), but requires canopy blocking to avoid O(N^2) pairwise comparisons.
